bea.notes: Annual 2000/2001 use the December 5, 2024 geographic workbook with its own provenance; the current workbook repeats the 2000 label and omits 2001. Later years use the current release.

bea_expanded.notes: Table 2.4 expanded geographic detail; public iTable GetStep POST, appid=62, stepnum=6, product=4, tablelist=30700, all years. Chinese, Hong Kong and Taiwan rows provide balance controls; only the directly published Macau history is imported. The separate USTR release vintages remain in the complete downloads, not spliced into this history.

comtrade.notes: U.S.-reported customs trade: exports FOB, imports CIF; intentionally not spliced with BEA balance-of-payments series.

hktb.notes: Monthly and matched January-July/August 2025/2026 nationality counts, manually verified in public HKTB reports. Checksums cover the versioned reviewed transcription, not publisher PDFs. Both stay-length components and successive cumulative totals reconcile with the retained first half.
hktb.vintage: HKTB July/August 2026 reports; selected U.S. facts reviewed 2026-10-24

iie.notes: IIE automatic retrieval is paused: its terms prohibit automated downloading and analysis. Previously reviewed IIE-hosted observations are retained, not newly checked. Historical aggregates are independently reviewed in government republications; exact retrieved URLs, checksums, vintages and dates remain on those rows. Separate direct retrieval and reuse permission has not been verified; public access is not commercial-use clearance.

macau_tourism.notes: Selected-market PDFs; unlisted U.S. values are missing, never zero. Latest complete annual market profile fills selected-market omissions. Arrivals exclude non-resident workers/students from 2008. Residence classification changed to issuing place of travel document in April 2015; transition is not comparable. Direct monthly and January-to-month counts for U.S.-issued travel documents, not U.S. residents. The current DSEC country workbook takes priority over a stale MGTO latest-report endpoint. Matched prior/current-year periods and two independent component controls are verified. MGTO site terms limit use to noncommercial purposes. Commercial reuse permission has not been verified; these exports do not grant publication rights.
macau_tourism.vintage: MGTO annual highlights through 2025; Market Performance 2008, 2010, 2015, 2024; DSEC Visitor Arrivals 2026-09, tables 1-5 and 9

moe.notes: Reported U.S.-nationality degree and non-degree students, not U.S. credit-program participants or tertiary degree-only counts. Historical snapshots do not establish later enrollment. CAU's original yearbook/MOE research table restores seven earlier/intermediate years; 2011, 2012 and 2014 overlap exactly with retained ministry reports. The reviewed 2017 ministry briefing ranks source countries without a U.S. count, so no number is inferred. Original statistical aggregates only; reports are not redistributed.
moe.vintage: MOE reporting years 2006-2016 and 2018; original and explicitly attributed republications

nbs_tourism.notes: Official China Statistical Yearbooks 2007, 2010, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2018 and 2019. Selected historical source vintages; source units converted from 10,000 person-times. Later bilateral all-mode counts are not verified here. Not leisure-only visitors, unique people, U.S. departures, or a series spliced to U.S. resident air-travel estimates.

ntto.notes: Workbook modification dates are not official publication dates.

ntto_siat.notes: U.S.-resident air-travel destination estimates, kept separate from all-mode visitor arrivals. Annual 2012–2020 and 2022–2025; separately selected Q1-Q2 observations in 2025 and 2026 support matched January–June comparisons. Quarter checkboxes are selected directly, not inferred by subtracting rounded annual and half-year totals. Monitor total-traveler and respondent cards read from the public report with explicit year, quarter and destination filters; source checksums identify retained browser-visible report text, not API responses. Estimates are rounded to 1,000; respondent counts appear in each observation's notes. Under-100 respondent bases are conservatively flagged low reliability. The 2021 monitor cards show zero volume despite positive respondent counts (China 267; Hong Kong 44); these contradictory volume outputs are not interpreted as zero actual travel. No aggregation across destinations.
ntto_siat.vintage: NTTO SIAT public monitor, 6 October 2026; through 2026 Q2

taiwan_tourism.notes: Public open-data CSV; scope differs from NTTO overnight trips.

uis.notes: Taiwan not separately listed; U.S.-to-mainland records may be absent.

ustr.notes: Separate direct USTR country estimates fill Macau services missing from the selected BEA workbook. Exports, imports, total services and surplus/deficit are checked together. Rounded nominal USD; not regional allocations or affiliate sales. Longer history not imputed.
ustr.vintage: USTR Macau Trade Summary; directly reported 2025 estimated services
